title: Roll the verified skills install out to mcp-gateway developer machines and capture evidence
description: Have the mcp-gateway engineers run the updated setup (src/setup, merged to main) on their developer machines on the developer-laptops dev tier recorded in applications/mcp-gateway/env/dev.json; confirm each global skills install reports the pinned agent-skills commit and a checksum-verified result, and attach the command output to this task as evidence. Constraints: coordinate the re-run so no engineer is mid-setup during the upgrade, and machines that already carry unverified global skill content from the pre-change setup must re-run the installer so existing content is replaced only after checksums verify.
acceptanceCriteria: Every mcp-gateway engineer's setup run prints the pinned agent-skills commit SHA and a verified-checksum summary, and the outputs are attached to this task as evidence
On a machine carrying pre-change global skill content, the updated installer replaces the content only after checksums verify and exits non-zero otherwise

verificationMethod.description: On one developer laptop on the dev tier, run the updated setup for two agents (e.g. claude-code and opencode) and observe every installed skill file reported as checksum-verified; then corrupt one checksum in a scratch clone and re-run. Expected result: the normal run completes with verified output for every file and the corrupted run exits non-zero, writing nothing to the global skills directory.

rootCause.description: Developer harnesses already carry third-party skills installed by the unverified setup path; the rollout converges existing global skill content on the pinned, checksum-verified source
